mapper.select: SELECT id, token, user_id, expires_at, last_ip, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM student_mobile_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1 AND expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_mobile_token (token, user_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE student_mobile_token SET is_active = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE student_mobile_token SET last_ip = #{lastIp}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
